observations: Actual pallet-like slatted geometry is visible with brown wood grain, front board faces, and gaps. The RGB contains no selected-part highlight or ownership palette.
The wood pattern is visibly regular/procedural; floor and lighting are plain. This is rendering feasibility, not a claim of photorealistic domain match.
Separate part152 support and visible masks look like one elongated board-region projection. This does not establish a semantic role or native8 association.
All mesh components received the same wood appearance; possible metal/fastener identity has not been independently verified.
